_note: Planet x angle effect table for astrocartography. AC=Ascendant, DC=Descendant, MC=Midheaven, IC=Imum Coeli. Effects describe the broad life-theme amplified when a person relocates near that planetary line.

IC.effect: Focus on home, roots, father, ancestry. Inner foundation strengthens; less public momentum.
